integrity: The ideal list and adjacency rules follow from divisor ideals and divisibility. Independent sets are classified by the largest selected q-bearing ideal, which yields both the polynomial and all maximal facets. Exhaustive small cases and direct ideal-product constructions corroborate the proof.
scientific_limitations: The modulus has exactly two distinct prime divisors and one exponent is one.
The polynomial determines the repeated-prime exponent but not the prime values.
The result concerns the standard annihilating-ideal graph.
No arbitrary two-exponent Z_n formula is claimed.
title: Independence polynomial and all maximal independent sets of semiprime-power annihilating-ideal graphs
